dxgive.evidence_source: To qualify for inclusion in the study, students were required to satisfy all of the following criteria: (a) a BDI score of 12 or greater; (b) a RADS score of 72 or greater; (c) a BID score of 20 or greater; (d) no current use of medication or other treatment for depression or related disorders; and (e) willingness to participate in a treatment program.
